section_previews_by_key.12:prayer: Father, thank You for speaking clearly in Acts 9:40-43. In this passage You bring resurrection mercy that leaves the servant ready for the next ordinary assignment into the open through Peter stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon. Lord, keep us from reading these words as distant history only, and press them into our ordinary obedience today. Where we resist the truth highlighted in this reflection, bring repentance and renewed trust. Lift our hearts into resurrection courage, and keep us from living as though death still has the final word. Holy Spirit, take what we have seen in the exposition and turn it into worship instead of mere information. Teach us to remember that Acts 9:40-43 opens with a scene marked by resurrection mercy that leaves the servant ready for the next ordinary assignment. Guard our speech from haste, our work from pride, and our choices from whatever would pull us away from living hope instead of defeated resignation. Amen.
